sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm cycling to an island to see my cousin's new café.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the ferry dock, I see stairs beside the ticket counter.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I take my bike on the ferry?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, there's room for bikes on the next one.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'd like a ticket to the island, please.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's six pounds, and the bike goes free.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll pay by card.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here you go. Just wait behind that yellow line.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got a sandwich in this bag on the bike.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I take the bag off before getting on?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You can leave it there if it's fixed on properly.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check the bag, then look back at the stairs.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Will I have to carry the bike down those stairs?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, those lead to the small boats.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That's a relief. This bike's quite heavy.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: When the ferry comes in, we'll put the ramp down.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So I can just push the bike onto the ferry?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly. Walk beside it, and we'll show you where to park.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The ferry pulls in, and a few people get off.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You can get on once the last passenger's off, but wait behind the line.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, should I go now or wait here?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Wait here till everyone's off.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Got it, I'll stay behind the line.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, you're good to go now.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I push my bike up the ramp beside the same worker.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Put it against that rail. I'll tie it on for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks. Can I sit upstairs during the trip?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, take anything you'll need out of your bag first.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Good idea. I'll take my sandwich and leave the bike here.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: From upstairs, I spot my cousin's café across the water.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She's outside waving, so I wave back with my sandwich.
